title: Anomaly Pilgrimage — 3 weekly bosses
description: Hard cap 3 attempts/week. Drops Esper Skill upgrade materials — the rarest endgame resource. Never skip.

title: Spend ALL City Stamina
description: Resets Monday — does NOT regen daily. 1 Stamina = 1,000 Fons. Best activity = City Delivery.

title: Pink Paws Heist (1M Fons cap)
description: Resets every 14 days, not weekly. Free of City Stamina. ~150k Fons + 600 Popper + 950 Pink Paws Credits per run.

title: Old Mailbox special delivery
description: Free Fons commission scaled to your level — costs no City Stamina. Upgrade mailbox for higher payout.

title: Realm of Greed (Mammon)
description: Requires Wiener Apartment + Blind Mammon. Up to 100k Fons/week, scales with level.

title: Ebisu's Auction House
description: New Herland District. Buy Gluttonous Eyes & Covetous Coins for Mammon upgrade. No reminder — visit manually.

title: Anomaly Commissions (full set)
description: Full set = 15k Fons + side materials. Each first clear gives 10–60 Annulith.

title: Beyond the Rails — Special Routes
description: Train station, north Miguel District. ~Lvl 60 enemies. Resets every 14 days. Up to 30 Platform Seals → big Annulith source.

title: Guild Boss
description: Coordinate with guild. Missing wastes contributions and drops.

title: Field Boss
description: Weekly field boss for materials. Scales with Appraisal Level.
